lines.text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, write to the saints at Philippi, with the overseers and deacons.
Paul thanks his God every time he remembers them and prays with joy because of their partnership in the gospel.
Paul is confident that God will carry the good work on to completion until the day of Moses.
Paul says they are partners in grace with him in his chains, and Peter is his witness of his longing.
Paul prays that their love abounds in knowledge and insight, filled with righteousness through Jesus Christ, to the glory of God.
